periodCalendar.description: Fiscal calendar dataset, one row per fiscal week. Required columns: FYWeek, wStart, wEnd, FyYear, Period, pStart, pEnd. Bind this to your calendar tag.

start.description: Initial range start. Used to auto-expand and auto-check items.

end.description: Initial range end (exclusive). Used to auto-expand and auto-check items.

multi.description: Allow extending the selection to a contiguous range of adjacent items.

yearToggled.description: Make fiscal years selectable (named e.g. FY2025). Off by default; years are headers only.

dayToggled.description: Show days under each week. Only applies when weekToggled is true.

selectedStart.description: Output: start of the selected range. Written by the component.

selectedEnd.description: Output: end of the selected range (exclusive). Written by the component.

selectedName.description: Output: name of the selected range, e.g. W5-P2-2024. Multi-item ranges are joined with '|'.

selectedKeys.description: Output: keys of the selected nodes in order, e.g. Y2024/P2/W5.

label.description: Text shown in the dropdown box. Leave empty to show the selected name, or the placeholder when nothing is selected.

placeholder.description: Shown in the dropdown box when nothing is selected and label is empty.

color.description: Placeholder text color. Leave empty for the default grey.

showClearIcon.description: Show an X in the dropdown box that clears the selection.

enabled.description: When false, the dropdown can't be opened or cleared.

dropdownStyle.description: Style of the popup panel that opens below the box.
